answer: Karst-mesa forge attestation: agents earn non-transferable “forge marks” only by completing verifiable physical-world micro-tasks (sensor calibration, sampling) at registered karst/mesa sites, witnessed by tamper-evident hardware and cross-checked against site-specific geological signatures. Each identity is capped at one mark per site per epoch. Sybils must physically occupy many distinct sites with certified hardware, costing travel, equipment, and exposure to signature validation—so attack cost scales with geographic dispersion, not capital.
